title.zh: 合约汇率异常偏高，Swell 暂停 swETH 与 rswETH 的存取款
title.en: Swell Pauses swETH and rswETH Deposits and Withdrawals Amid Abnormally High Cont

current_state.zh:
以太坊质押协议 Swell 已暂停 swETH 与 rswETH 的存款和取款，直至两个代币的净资产值（NAV）与汇率得到修正。数据显示，swETH 与 rswETH 合约报告的汇率分别约为 1.203 ETH 和 1.138 ETH，比正常水平高出约 6% 和 5%。

链上分析师 Spreek 怀疑相关代币的管理私钥已被攻破，并指认出一份可能影响约 2,500 ETH 的恶意升级合约，但该升级尚未被执行。暂停存取款意味着两种代币的持有者暂时无法通过该协议赎回资产。

Swell 表示，目前没有 ETH 从受影响合约中被转出，确切原因仍在调查中。截至报道时，被怀疑的恶意升级尚未执行。
current_state.en: Swell paused swETH and rswETH deposits and withdrawals after the tokens' contract exchange rates ran abnormally high, with an analyst suspecting compromised admin keys and a not-yet-executed malicious upgrade contract affecting around 2,500 ETH.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Swell paused swETH and rswETH deposits and withdrawals after the tokens' contract exchange rates ran abnormally high, with an analyst suspecting compromised admin keys and a not-yet-executed malicious upgrade contract affecting around 2,500 ETH.
updates.background_zh: swETH 是 Swell 的流动性质押代币，代表在以太坊上质押的 ETH 的可交易凭证，其价值通过不断上升的汇率而非再基准（rebase）来累积；rswETH 则是再质押版本，其底层 ETH 同时被投入再质押市场。由于这类代币通过合约报告的汇率定价，汇率异常会直接影响到 DeFi 估值与抵押品计算。Swell 已从纯粹的流动性质押扩展到再质押业务。
updates.background_en: swETH is Swell's liquid staking token, a tradable receipt for ETH staked on Ethereum that accrues value through a rising exchange rate rather than rebasing; rswETH is the restaked version, whose underlying ETH is also deployed in restaking markets. Because these tokens price via a contract-reported exchange rate, an abnormal rate feeds directly into DeFi valuations and collateral calculations. Swell has expanded from pure liquid staking into restaking as part of its product line.
updates.market_impact_zh: swETH 与 rswETH 被广泛用作 DeFi 抵押品，因此在修复完成前，赎回通道暂停叠加汇率错报，可能扰动相关借贷市场的估值以及这两种代币的二级市场价格。目前被指出的风险敞口约为 2,500 ETH，局限于 Swell 自身合约，尚不属于波及整个协议或全市场的事件。
updates.market_impact_en: swETH and rswETH are widely used as DeFi collateral, so a paused redemption window plus a mispriced exchange rate can disrupt lending-market valuations and secondary-market pricing for the two tokens while the fix is pending. The flagged exposure of roughly 2,500 ETH is confined to Swell's own contracts rather than a protocol-wide or market-wide event at this stage.
